title: How the Outpatient Surgery Post-Payment Refund Is Figured — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Reimbursement Analysis memo.** On an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) refunded after an upheld post-payment denial of outpatient surgery, Riverbend treats the denial as reaching every service of the account except the pre-operative tests, which its payer agreements keep payable as outpatient diagnostics: every charge under revenue codes 0300 (laboratory tests, blood-bank typing and specimen collection), 0730 (electrocardiogram tracings) and 0324 (chest radiographs).

**Quantities and their records**
1. *Payment received*: the claim's payer payments less any payer recoveries already on the claim.
2. *Pre-operative tests*: read from the charge postings of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) by their charges — the laboratory codes 85025, 80048 and 85610 under revenue code 0300 each; the blood-bank typing codes 86900 and 86901 under revenue code 0300 together; the venipuncture code 36415, the urinalysis code 81001, the tracing code 93005 and the radiograph code 71046 each; and every other charge under revenue codes 0300, 0730 and 0324.
3. *Retained value*: the charges of the pre-operative tests multiplied by the payer class's expected allowed percentage of charges (the payer-class figure in the contract modeling schedule).
4. *Refund*: the payment received less the retained value, never below 0.00.

**Assembly.** Each group of tests is valued at no more than that group's billed charges (Riverbend's agreements pay the lesser of the scheduled amount and the billed charges); the group values are then added, the sum is taken from the payment received (never below 0.00), and the total is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final total. When the refund is 0.00 no entry is written.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures, payer class modeled at 50%).**
| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Payer payments | 4,000.00 |
| Payer recoveries already on the claim | 0.00 |
| Payment received | 4,000.00 |
| Pre-operative test charges (revenue codes 0300, 0730, 0324) | 600.00 |
| Retained value: 600.00 at 50% | 300.00 |
| Refund: 4,000.00 less 300.00 | 3,700.00 |

If the retained value were larger than the payment received, the refund would be 0.00 and no entry would be written.
